title: The size-Ramsey numbers of $k$-uniform relaxed $\ell$-trees
summary: The size-Ramsey number $\widehat{R}_k(\mathcal G)$ of a $k$-uniform hypergraph $\mathcal G$ is the minimum number of edges in a $k$-uniform hypergraph $\mathcal H$ such that every $2$-edge-coloring of $\mathcal H$ contains a monochromatic copy of $\mathcal G$. Fox asked whether, for fixed $2\le \ell 0$ depends only on $k$ and $\ell$. Moreover, any two distinct edges of the construction intersect in at most $2\ell-k-1$ vertices.
